gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-preahvihear: Plakkaat is heavy and bold, drawn like bent straw, its terminals curling inward until each letter feels almost sealed shut. Preahvihear lets paragraphs breathe through open mouths and a lofty x-height.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption has big-bodied lowercase and bowls left inviting open. Across a full page those unclosed bowls keep paragraphs moving, a loose counterweight to the heavy, closed letters of Plakkaat.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-puritan: Approachable rounded forms in Puritan stay open to the side, set against Plakkaat and its bold, closed, bent-straw letters. Made small, Plakkaat's heavy shapes would crowd together fast.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-radio-canada: Plakkaat packs bold, heavy letters whose terminals curl around toward the stem. Radio Canada runs a steady monoline with clear openings at each curve's end, so paragraphs stay light by comparison.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-radio-canada-big: Terminals that curl around until they almost meet the stem give Plakkaat its closed, heavy look. And Radio Canada Big opens everything back up, its monoline strokes stopping well away from the stem.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-ruda: Plakkaat is heavy, closed, and built to be noticed straight away. Ruda handles the quieter job, its sizable x-height and wide-mouthed rounds suited to screen reading, where Plakkaat grabs attention.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sen: Heavy, bent-straw lettering: Plakkaat curls its terminals nearly shut. Sen takes the opposite route, with high-standing lowercase and constant-weight curves that stop before turning inward, which keeps long paragraphs moving.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sintony: Sintony brings a chunky midzone and smooth curves that never clog, standing opposite the heavy, closed letters of Plakkaat. One shouts, the other talks, and both stay legible.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sofia-sans: Modern, with rounded letters open to the side, Sofia Sans has no stroke variation at all, unlike heavy Plakkaat. And its stencil-like lowercase holds up well if the body is sized up a notch.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Terminals sweeping around toward the stem close every heavy Plakkaat letter, while Sofia Sans Semi Condensed opens up. Let its stencil-cut lowercase run a size larger than you'd expect.
